name: heart
description: A balanced heart with full lobes and a softened lower point in a solid filled style.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: Filled lobes and point are separately expanded to match Outline apparent size. No artificial counters or interior strokes. Bounds x=2.4..21.6, y=3.25..20.75 are centered. Separately authored fill-only study; counters are fixed geometry. Not owner-approved. The upper lobes curl inward toward a deeper y=5.8 notch, paired with the Outline revision; outer bounds and lower point remain unchanged.
